stem.text: Menthol is a naturally occurring alcohol.

stem.alt: C10H20O (menthol), skeletal structure of a cyclohexane ring with a methyl, an isopropyl group and an OH group.
stem.label: menthol

stem.text: When menthol is heated with concentrated sulfuric acid it reacts. The products formed include compound T.
What is the structure of compound T?

A.alt: Skeletal structure: methylcyclohexane ring with an exocyclic C=C bond to an isopropylidene group.

B.alt: Skeletal structure: methylcyclohexanone-type ring with a C=O group and an isopropyl group.

C.alt: Skeletal structure: cyclohexene ring (one C=C in the ring) with a methyl group and an isopropyl group.

D.alt: Skeletal structure: cyclohexene ring (one C=C in the ring) with a methyl group and an isopropyl group.
